description: Defines a class 'TestConstants' that contains various static constants used for testing within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things' package. The constants include identifiers, headers, JSON selectors, authorization subjects, ACL entries, and detailed properties related to 'Thing' objects, features, attributes, and lifecycle states.
